# ex: needParen in various outer contexts (selector, index, call.Fun)
ex {
	var x int
	x -> x * 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{ X int }

var t T

func F() {
	f := func(int) int { return 0 }
	_ = f(t.X)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,6 +5,6 @@
 var t T

 func F() {
-	f := func(int) int { return 0 }
-	_ = f(t.X)
+	f := func(int) int { return 0 * 2 }
+	_ = f(t.X*2) * 2
 }
